title: Workmanship Warranties Billing Note: Amount of the Mechanical Diagnostic Charge
content:
The mechanical diagnostic charge on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty concern, under the Workmanship Warranties, is the plan's standard diagnostic fee, charged in full once for the concern, in US dollars rounded to the cent. The charge is never below zero.

## Reading the rule

- **Which fee.** The plan's standard diagnostic fee as the plan's rate card states it for the plan the coverage is held under.
- **How much of it.** The fee in full.
- **How often.** Once for the concern; each mechanical-part concern found not covered is its own concern.
- **Precision and floor.** US dollars rounded to the cent, never below zero.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

With a hypothetical standard diagnostic fee of USD 88.00, a mechanical part concern found not covered is charged USD 88.00. A second mechanical part concern on the same coverage found not covered is charged its own USD 88.00.
